title: useSearchParams
summary: Read the current query string and replace it through navigation.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: The hook takes no arguments. The setter accepts URLSearchParams or Record<string, string>, followed by optional NavigateOptions. It does not accept a callback updater.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns [params, setParams]. params is memoized from the current URL search string. Changing that object does not navigate; call setParams explicitly. The setter replaces the query string and omits the previous hash.

sections.title: Preserving other fields
sections.body: Clone the current parameters before changing a field. Use URLSearchParams for repeated keys; an ordinary record supports one value per key.

sections.title: Loading and revalidation
sections.body: Setting parameters performs navigation to the current pathname, so the active loader may run. shouldRevalidate receives the old and new URLs and can decline that reload. Use a GET fetcher form when search results should be independent of the browser address.
